# openmetadata_policy (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Policy by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_policy" "data_access" {
  name = "DataAccessControl"
}

output "policy_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_policy.data_access.id
}

output "policy_enabled" {
  value = data.openmetadata_policy.data_access.enabled
}

# rules is returned as a JSON string; use jsondecode() to inspect it in HCL
output "policy_rules" {
  value = data.openmetadata_policy.data_access.rules
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the policy to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the policy.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of domains this policy belongs to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the policy.
- `id` (String) UUID of the policy.
- `location` (String) UUID of the location where this policy is applied.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this policy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `rules` (String) Policy rules as a JSON string, as returned by the OpenMetadata API.

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
